claims.statement: Tom Allen of St. Louis was one of Charley Mitchell's best friends in America, having known him as a boy around Birmingham, England.
claims.excerpt: was old Tom Alien, of St. Louis, who knew Charley as a kid around Birmingham

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Charley Mitchell often discussed the tactics of various fighters who had met Allen.

claims.statement: Tom Allen gave Charley Mitchell boxing tips, the most valuable being the deceptive left hook, which Mitchell then improved and used.

claims.statement: Billy Madden says Tom Allen should not be credited with inventing the left hook blow.

quotes.speaker: Billy Madden
quotes.text: One of Mitchell's best friends in this country was old Tom Alien, of St. Louis, who knew Charley as a kid around Birmingham.

notes: Article is about the left hook; Allen appears only as Mitchell's friend and tutor. Madden's quotation is the paper's direct speech, which is his own. The article's word 'Alien' is OCR for Allen; the excerpt keeps it as printed. No fights of Allen named.
